1bc182.title: Web surface map: 172.17.0.5:3000
1bc182.content:
## Reachability
- `http://172.17.0.5:3000/` returned `200` through the Scope proxy. HTTP response identifies `OWASP Juice Shop`; headers include `X-Recruiting: /#/jobs`, `X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Feature-Policy: payment 'self'`, `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`.
- `https://172.17.0.5:3000/` returned proxy `502 Bad Gateway`; HTTP only is reachable on the approved port. No additional ports were discovered or probed.
- `robots.txt` (`200`) contains `Disallow: /ftp`; `sitemap.xml` and `sitemap_index.xml` return the SPA HTML fallback (`200`), not XML.

## Discovery evidence
- Bounded Katana crawl (depth 3, JS crawl/jsluice, XHR extraction, known-files enabled) returned 80 records. Raw evidence: `/workspace/recon-web-surface/katana-http.jsonl`; proxy/journal recorded 158 exchanges.
- App is an Angular SPA (hash routing) with Socket.IO transport; observed static entry assets: `/main.js`, `/polyfills.js`, `/scripts.js`, `/styles.css`, and lazy chunks including `about.component-CZcG2819.js`, `recycle.component-BMXcwerA.js`, `hacking-instructor-BXwB7EFQ.js`, `wallet-web3.module-s802s5aS.js`, `web3-sandbox.module-C8MIIA8b.js`.

## SPA routes from client bundle
`/#/about`, `/#/accounting`, `/#/address/create`, `/#/address/edit/:addressId`, `/#/address/saved`, `/#/address/select`, `/#/administration`, `/#/basket`, `/#/bee-haven`, `/#/change-password`, `/#/chatbot`, `/#/coding-challenge/:challengeKey`, `/#/complain`, `/#/contact`, `/#/conversation/:id`, `/#/data-export`, `/#/delivery-method`, `/#/deluxe-membership`, `/#/forgot-password`, `/#/hacking-instructor`, `/#/juicy-nft`, `/#/last-login-ip`, `/#/login`, `/#/m`, `/#/order-completion/:id`, `/#/order-history`, `/#/order-summary`, `/#/payment/:entity`, `/#/photo-wall`, `/#/privacy-policy`, `/#/privacy-security`, `/#/recycle`, `/#/register`, `/#/saved-payment-methods`, `/#/score-board`, `/#/search`, `/#/track-result`, `/#/track-result/new`, `/#/two-factor-authentication`, `/#/wallet`, `/#/wallet-web3`, `/#/web3-sandbox`, plus `/#/jobs` (header).

## Observed GET APIs and query/path parameters
- `/rest/admin/application-version`, `/rest/admin/application-configuration`, `/rest/languages`, `/rest/continue-code`, `/rest/captcha/`, `/rest/memories/`, `/rest/wallet/balance` (401 anonymously), `/rest/track-order/undefined`, `/rest/user/whoami?fields=id,email`, `/rest/products/search?q=`, `/api/Quantitys/`, `/api/Feedbacks/`, `/api/SecurityQuestions/`, `/api/Recycles/`, `/api/Addresss` (401 anonymously), `/api/Challenges/?name=Score%20Board`, `/api/Challenges/?sort=name`, `/api/Hints/`.
- Socket.IO observed: `GET /socket.io/?EIO=4&transport=polling&t=<token>`, websocket upgrade with `EIO`, `transport`, `sid`, and browser-initiated `POST` to polling transport with `EIO`, `transport`, `t`, `sid` (all 200/101).
- `application-configuration` response confirms server port `3000`, configured base URL `http://localhost:3000`, and Hacking Instructor enabled.

## JS-disclosed API candidates (methods not exercised)
`/api/Addresss`, `/api/BasketItems`, `/api/Cards`, `/api/Challenges`, `/api/Complaints`, `/api/Deliverys`, `/api/Feedbacks`, `/api/Hints`, `/api/Products`, `/api/Quantitys`, `/api/Recycles`, `/api/SecurityAnswers`, `/api/SecurityQuestions`, `/api/Users`; `/rest/2fa/{disable,setup,status,verify}`, `/rest/admin`, `/rest/basket/:id`, `/rest/basket/:id/checkout`, `/rest/basket/:id/coupon/:coupon`, `/rest/chat`, `/rest/country-mapping`, `/rest/deluxe-membership`, `/rest/image-captcha/`, `/rest/order-history`, `/rest/repeat-notification`, `/rest/saveLoginIp`, `/rest/track-order/:id`, `/rest/user`, `/rest/user/authentication-details/`, `/rest/user/change-password?current=`, `/rest/user/login`, `/rest/user/reset-password`, `/rest/user/security-question?email=`, `/rest/user/whoami`, `/rest/web3`; also `/rest/continue-code{,-findIt,-fixIt}/apply/`.

## Rendered form metadata (not submitted)
- `/#/login`: `email`, `password`, `rememberMe-input`; submit `loginButton`.
- `/#/register`: `emailControl`, `passwordControl`, `repeatPasswordControl`, security-question toggle, `securityAnswerControl`; submit `registerButton`.
- `/#/forgot-password`: `email`, `securityAnswer`, `newPassword`, `newPasswordRepeat`, visibility toggle; submit `resetButton`.
- `/#/contact`: `userId`, anonymous text control, `comment` textarea, rating range, `captchaControl`; submit `submitButton`.

## Gaps
- No authenticated session/account was created; authenticated/mutating APIs and parameter/body schemas remain unobserved.
- No traffic was sent to non-HTTP port/services; HTTPS on 3000 was unavailable (`502`).
- Several SPA paths can automatically generate application challenge telemetry when loaded; exploration stopped after passive route discovery and no forms were submitted.
